svg.aria-label: Common grid checkbox 14px for binary flags e.g. approve
svg.desc: 14x14 px, rx=2. Center in cell: x = column_center - 7, y = row_top + (row_height - 14) / 2 (row h 34 gives +10). Use for use/write/decrypt/approve flags in dense grids. Ref: generate_req_20260323_approver_svgs.py CB_SZ. Legacy pill: common-grid-toggle-pill.svg.
